scientific_integrity: Every vertex subset, face incidence and signed Morse degree is rederived by a standalone Python 3 verifier. Independent scientific validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact nonequivariant classification for a single explicitly defined finite graph; no family theorem, persistence maps, integral automorphism module or generalization to higher bipartite Kneser graphs; unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Forty-one seven-spheres in the Desargues second-independence complex
